name: Holocausto
description: '''Holocausto''' is a [[thrash metal]] band from [[Belo Horizonte]], Brazil, formed in 1985 by Marco Antônio, Valério Exterminator and Rodrigo dos Anjos. They have released five records through [[Cogumelo Records]]. Journalist Eduardo Rivadavia described them as "possibly the most controversial Brazilian heavy metal band ever".
